metrics.label: Iran Deaths Documented by HRANA
metrics.scope: 28 February-7 April 2026: 1,701 civilian, 1,221 military and 714 unclassified deaths. Not a September total.
metrics.verification_note: Sum of HRANA's three non-overlapping categories; classifications remain subject to revision.
metrics.note: Sum of HRANA's three non-overlapping categories; classifications remain subject to revision.

metrics.label: Iran Injuries Reported by Health Ministry
metrics.source: WHO EMRO, situation report 6, citing Iran MoH
metrics.scope: Ministry total through 7 April, published by WHO on 16 April. Not independently verified or a September count.
metrics.source_name: WHO EMRO, situation report 6, citing Iran MoH
metrics.verification_note: WHO reports more than 32,314 injuries; no severity-specific breakdown used.
metrics.note: WHO reports more than 32,314 injuries; no severity-specific breakdown used.

metrics.label: Deaths in Israel from Direct Missile / Rocket Strikes
metrics.source: Ynet, Operation Roaring Lion casualty review
metrics.scope: First 40 days, ending at the April ceasefire. Includes fire from Iran and Lebanon and victims of different nationalities. Excludes combat abroad and indirect deaths.
metrics.source_name: Ynet, Operation Roaring Lion casualty review
metrics.verification_note: Uses the explicit 22 direct-strike deaths, not the broader 42-person war-related tally.
metrics.note: Uses the explicit 22 direct-strike deaths, not the broader 42-person war-related tally.

metrics.label: Israel Hospital Evacuations Reported
metrics.scope: Operation Roaring Lion cumulative hospital evacuations through 17 April, 07:00 local time. Broader than confirmed direct-strike wounds.
metrics.verification_note: Official bulletin reports 7,834 injured persons evacuated to hospitals; 78 remained hospitalized.
metrics.note: Official bulletin reports 7,834 injured persons evacuated to hospitals; 78 remained hospitalized.

metrics.label: US Service Member Deaths Reported
metrics.scope: Combined Operation Epic Fury and subsequent Overseas Operations tally. Includes operational deaths, not only hostile-fire deaths.
metrics.note: Published tally of 18; not a live September count.
metrics.verification_note: Published tally of 18; not a live September count.

metrics.label: US Service Members Wounded (All Severities)
metrics.scope: Epic Fury and Overseas Operations combined. Replaces the incorrect seriously-injured label. Not a September live count.
metrics.note: Article reports 757 overall, although its service subtotals sum to 756. Displayed as a reported claim, not an audited total.
metrics.verification_note: Article reports 757 overall, although its service subtotals sum to 756. Displayed as a reported claim, not an audited total.

metrics.label: Missiles UAE Reports Intercepting
metrics.source: UAE Ministry of Defence via Khaleej Times
metrics.scope: UAE only: 537 ballistic plus 26 cruise missiles since the conflict began. Replaces the unsupported regional launch total; not impact sites.
metrics.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence via Khaleej Times
metrics.verification_note: Official interception claim, not independently established interceptions or all Iranian launches.
metrics.note: Official interception claim, not independently established interceptions or all Iranian launches.

metrics.label: Drones UAE Reports Intercepting
metrics.source: UAE Ministry of Defence via Khaleej Times
metrics.scope: UAE cumulative claim. Replaces the unsupported region-wide drone launch count. Does not establish individual map locations.
metrics.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence via Khaleej Times
metrics.verification_note: The cited report attributes 2,256 interceptions to UAE air defence.
metrics.note: The cited report attributes 2,256 interceptions to UAE air defence.

metrics.label: Total Reported Killed
metrics.scope: No substantiated figure for this metric and reporting period.
metrics.verification_note: No comparable regional total: reviewed reports cover different dates, countries and direct/indirect deaths. Adding these cards would misrepresent coverage.

metrics.label: Total Reported Injured
metrics.scope: No substantiated figure for this metric and reporting period.
metrics.verification_note: No comparable regional total: hospital evacuations and wounded-person reports use different definitions and dates. The country reports remain available separately.

metrics.label: UAE Air Defence Engagements
metrics.source: UAE Ministry of Defence via Gulf Today
metrics.scope: UAE cumulative engagements through 27 March 2026: 378 ballistic missiles + 15 cruise missiles + 1,835 UAVs. Not confirmed interceptions or a region-wide total.
metrics.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence via Gulf Today
metrics.verification_note: The cited report supports the sum 2,228 and uses engaged, not destroyed. Official claim, not independently verified.
metrics.note: The cited report supports the sum 2,228 and uses engaged, not destroyed. Official claim, not independently verified.

metrics.label: Iran Civilian Properties Reported Damaged
metrics.scope: Iranian Red Crescent claim through 31 March 2026. Includes homes and commercial premises, not only critical infrastructure. Not independently verified.
metrics.verification_note: Report states more than 113,000 civilian places damaged. No current September total established.
metrics.note: Report states more than 113,000 civilian places damaged. No current September total established.

metrics.label: Conflict Duration (days)
metrics.scope: No substantiated figure for this metric and reporting period.
metrics.verification_note: Elapsed time since 28 February is not active combat duration: ceasefires and subsequent operations interrupt the period. No continuous-war duration asserted.

metrics.label: US-Israeli Strike Events (ACLED)
metrics.source: ACLED Iran crisis data, 10 September release
metrics.scope: 28 February-7 September. Location/day events include air, missile and drone attacks, including interceptions; not individual weapons or solely airstrikes.
metrics.source_name: ACLED Iran crisis data, 10 September release
metrics.verification_note: ACLED's published cumulative event count; subject to verification and revision.
metrics.note: ACLED's published cumulative event count; subject to verification and revision.

metrics.label: Russian Military Deaths (CSIS Estimate)
metrics.source: Center for Strategic and International Studies
metrics.scope: Estimated range for February 2022-June 2026. Not a named-person verified count or September total.
metrics.source_name: Center for Strategic and International Studies
metrics.verification_note: CSIS estimates 400,000-450,000 military fatalities.
metrics.note: CSIS estimates 400,000-450,000 military fatalities.

metrics.label: Russian Military Casualties (CSIS Estimate)
metrics.source: Center for Strategic and International Studies
metrics.scope: February 2022-June 2026; includes killed, wounded and missing. Replaces the unsupported wounded-only count. Deaths are already included; do not add the cards.
metrics.source_name: Center for Strategic and International Studies
metrics.verification_note: No wounded-only estimate can be derived by subtracting fatalities because missing personnel are included.
metrics.note: No wounded-only estimate can be derived by subtracting fatalities because missing personnel are included.

metrics.label: Air Defense Intercepts (7d)
metrics.scope: No substantiated figure for this metric and reporting period.
metrics.verification_note: No substantiated seven-day interception total for the reviewed week. ACLED strike events include attacks, not a successful-interception count.

metrics.label: Air and Drone Strike Events
metrics.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Event counts, not individual weapons.
metrics.verification_note: Published weekly ACLED count, subject to revision.
metrics.note: Published weekly ACLED count, subject to revision.

metrics.label: Russian Attacks on Civilian Infrastructure
metrics.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Attack events, not unique damaged facilities.
metrics.verification_note: Infrastructure subcategories overlap and must not be summed.
metrics.note: Infrastructure subcategories overlap and must not be summed.

metrics.label: Armed Clashes (Weekly Events)
metrics.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Replaces the unsupported pressure index with a documented event count.
metrics.verification_note: Not a percentage, territorial gain measure or intensity score.
metrics.note: Not a percentage, territorial gain measure or intensity score.

metrics.label: Internally Displaced People in Ukraine
metrics.source: IOM estimate via UNHCR data portal
metrics.scope: People displaced within Ukraine as of 30 June. Excludes refugees abroad; displayed in people, not millions.
metrics.source_name: IOM estimate via UNHCR data portal
metrics.verification_note: Survey-based population estimate, not a complete individual registry.
metrics.note: Survey-based population estimate, not a complete individual registry.

metrics.label: Energy Infrastructure Attack Events (Weekly)
metrics.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Replaces the unsupported 30-day damaged-site count; events can affect the same site more than once.
metrics.verification_note: Energy-tagged events are a subset of infrastructure attacks, not additional events.
metrics.note: Energy-tagged events are a subset of infrastructure attacks, not additional events.

metrics.label: Drone Wave Incidents (7d)
metrics.scope: No substantiated figure for this metric and reporting period.
metrics.verification_note: No separately substantiated drone-wave count. The documented combined air/drone event count is shown under operations; a wave and a location/day event are not equivalent.

metrics.label: Frontline Settlement Changes (7d)
metrics.scope: No substantiated figure for this metric and reporting period.
metrics.verification_note: No independently reconciled weekly settlement-change count. ACLED describes advances but warns of exaggerated control claims; armed clashes do not measure territorial changes.
